# ARIADNE — Mechanistic Partner Discovery
====================================

### RANKED PARTNERS

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | craniofacial anomalies and anterior segment dysgenesis syndrome (MONDO:0013618) | shared gene | Tier 1 | 0.666 | HGNC:12723 |

### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. craniofacial anomalies and anterior segment dysgenesis syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.666)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:12723)

**Proposed mechanism:** VSX1 pathogenic variant (HP:0000745) —DISRUPTS→ VSX1 (HGNC:12723); VSX1 (HGNC:12723) —DECREASES→ Ocular development and differentiation (GO:0001654); Ocular development and differentiation (GO:0001654) —LEADS_TO→ Keratoconus (HP:0000745); Ocular development and differentiation (GO:0001654) —LEADS_TO→ Anterior segment dysgenesis (HP:0000514). Loss-of-function mutations in VSX1 disrupt ocular development pathways, leading to keratoconus and anterior segment dysgenesis.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in VSX1 in individuals with craniofacial anomalies and anterior segment dysgenesis syndrome that cause a gain-of-function effect, or identification of a distinct causal gene for one of the diseases that does not interact with VSX1. _(variant: rs779600028)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the role of VSX1 in ocular development may lead to targeted therapies for both keratoconus and craniofacial anomalies and anterior segment dysgenesis syndrome, potentially involving gene therapy or small molecule modulators to restore VSX1 function.
